segments.name: Franchising
segments.description: Franchises value-oriented resale retail store concepts to franchisees who buy, sell and trade used merchandise.
segments.evidence: As of December 27, 2025, we have one reportable operating segment, franchising, and one non-reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Franchisees pay royalties and franchise fees for the right to operate resale stores under the company's brands.
revenueModel.evidence: We then enter into franchise agreements with franchisees and grant the franchisee the right to use our business brand, service marks and operating system to manage a retail business.
